|game_text=Deploys -1 to [Episode I] locations. If you just lost Force to opponent’s Effect, may take an [Episode I] Interrupt (except Control) or place a card from hand under Credits Will Do Fine into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to Disarmed, You Are Beaten, and attrition.
|errata_history=Versions of [[Master Qui-Gon (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 12: Martyrs & Magistrates]], in date order (2 versions). Icons are written out in words. Found while comparing the Committee's 2008 re-issue of the sheet with the January 2007 sheet (Bill, 12 November 2026: every visibly different printing is a version).
* '''Original''' (this page): the release sheet “Virtual Set 12: Martyrs & Magistrates” (Players Committee, “Official text as of January 9, 2007”; PDF dated 10 January 2007; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154830/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards12.pdf VirtualCards12.pdf on swccgpc.com], Internet Archive capture of 24 October 2007), page 4, slip 16 ([[:File:OVS12-16-Master_Qui_Gon-slip-2007-01-09.png]]), in the Committee's Remaster template; game text as above.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Master Qui-Gon (V) (Virtual Set 12) (Errata)]]): the re-issued sheet (PDF dated 12 August 2008; headed “Official text as of January 9, 2007 (Errata to card #38 on March 21, 2008)”; [https://web.archive.org/web/20090220144753/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/virtual/VirtualCards12.pdf VirtualCards12.pdf on swccgpc.com], Internet Archive capture of 20 February 2009), page 4, slip 16 ([[:File:OVS12-16-Master_Qui_Gon-slip-2008-08-12.png]]). '''What changed:''' the words and numbers are unchanged; the credit line, printed in January 2007 sideways in the slip's side margins (“Original concept” / “by James Booker” / “Worlds” / “2005”), now runs along the bottom of the text box as one line: “Original concept by James Booker     Worlds 2005”. This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
